title: Rebuilding the copper mine around my little mining train — Railminer
author: ChritzleCraft
selftext:
I'm rebuilding the copper mine in Railminer, and this is the direction I'm working on. Both sides use the same camera and drill timing, so you can compare the wall while the train keeps mining.

AI has helped me with Unity code and Blender work. The part I'm checking here is whether the rougher rock and warmer lighting still let you follow each block coming out. What do you think?

The cave rework is still in development. The free Windows demo is on Steam if you'd like to try the mining and upgrades. Thanks for any feedback — and a wishlist helps if you enjoy it.

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5284470/Railminer/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5284470/Railminer/)

comments.author: Significant-Neck-520
comments.body: Looks like the rework improved a lot your graphics, nice work!
